title: chatbridge-ws
description: Minecraft mod that provides customizable formatting for bridge bot messages in the guild chat on Hypixel

## What it does

ChatBridge is a Fabric Minecraft mod that provides customizable formatting for bridge bot messages.\
\* Bridge Bot is a “player” that forwards messages from other Hypixel guilds or chat platforms (such as Discord) to the guild chat.

### Features
- Customization of bot messages.
- Customization of guild, officer, group, and private chats.
- Message timestamps and their customization.
- Hide warning about Discord links.
